metadata.title: A faithful representation and profinite completion
metadata.abstract: We exhibit two finitely generated residually finite groups $G_1$ and $G_2$ with isomorphic profinite completions $\widehat{G_1} \cong \widehat{G_2}$, such that $G_1$ has a faithful representation into $GL(d,\mathbb{C})$ but $G_2$ is not linear. This answers a question of Andrei Jaikin-Zapirain, Alexander Lubotzky, and Martin Bridson negatively. We also present two finitely generated residually finite groups $H_1$ and $H_2$ with isomorphic profinite completions $\widehat{H_1} \cong \widehat{H_2}$ satisfying the following. For every field $k$ with characteristic $p \geq 5$ and transcendence degree $r \geq 2$, there exists $d>0$ such that $H_1$ has a faithful representation into $GL(d,k)$. However, $H_2$ admits no faithful finite-dimensional representation over any field of positive characteristic.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 构造两有限生成剩余有限群，其前有限完备化同构，但一个在GL(d,C)中有忠实表示，另一个非线性，否定Jaikin-Zapirain、Lubotzky、Bridson的问题。另构造H₁,H₂有相同前有限完备化：每个特征p≥5、超越次数r≥2的域k上H₁都具有某个有限维忠实表示，而H₂在任何正特征域上均无有限维忠实表示。
techniques: 剩余有限群与前有限完备化
analysis.breakthrough: 说明忠实线性可表示性既在复数背景也在所述正特征背景不由前有限完备化决定。
analysis.limitations: H₁表示维数可依域变化，不声称统一维数；正面正特征结论要求p≥5和超越次数≥2，负面H₂则涵盖全部正特征域。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
